about_the_game:
Meet Omega!

Meet Omega — soldier to the bone on the battlefield and insatiable lover behind closed doors. Cloaked in an eerie glow, she slips into the dim light of your bedroom without a sound... But hold the alarm! Omega's just playing, slipping into the sultry role of a sinful mistress from a forgotten past!

To satisfy your desires, Omega will do anything. She's a whirlwind of passion when it comes to forbidden pleasure, unshaken by your wildest fetishes or most unhinged fantasies. She's so hot, she can't wait to slip out of that short little dress!


What You Get?

By purchasing this DLC, you'll unlock Omega in her Phantom Harlot form. You can switch mascots anytime by opening your in-game profile and checking the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you'll also receive 5000 Credits and 150 Super Serum.

But most importantly, you'll have our heartfelt thanks! We truly appreciate your support and hope you enjoy this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
